body:
We are excited to announce our partnership with Becker. In partnering with Becker, we are providing personalized learning for the CPA Exam. For 60 years, Becker has led CPA Exam preparation with a comprehensive study and coaching system. The new partnership optimizes student learning, and brings us closer to our mission in bringing the benefits of AI to education.

“We’ve had tremendous success with Becker’s approach to CPA Exam preparation, consistently producing top scorers”, said Mike Malee, president of Becker. “The addition of Sana Labs’ AI technology allows us to add even more value for our students, providing a personalized learning experience to help drive success on exam day.”

In survey results, about 90 percent of respondents reported that the new AI-powered personalized review sessions improved their efficiency and effectiveness in studying for the exam. More than 1 million professionals have prepared to advance their careers through the Becker CPA Exam Review. All students taking the CPA exam course now receive the new AI-based personalized learning experience, powered by Sana.

To learn more about personalizing education through AI, please contact Sana Labs by writing to [joel@sanalabs.com](mailto:joel@sanalabs.com).
